text: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Non-criminal Record Certificate -Please note that this document is valid for only 3 months. For instance, if you submit your -application in April, your non-criminal record must have been issued no earlier than January. -Obtain a police clearance certificate from the local police station where you currently reside, confirming no criminal record in the past 6 months at the time of application. -You need to translated it into CHINESE if it is not in Chinese; Then you need to get it notarized by local notary office and then get it certified by local Chinese embassy; If your country has joined the HAGUE convention then just do the Chinese translation and Apostille; Then you may need to mail original copy of non-criminal record and translation & certified(or Apostille) documents to the university in China. -If you are currently in China, the certificate must be issued by the local Chinese police. * 2. Certificate for High school education (or above level) A high school graduation certificate is required. * 3. Transcripts for each academic year of the previous education (or above level) An official seal or signature of the school is required on the transcripts. * 4. Colored ID photo The colored ID photo should be taken within 1 year. * 5. Colored copy of passport ID page The remaining validity period of the passport should be no less than 1 year, and the scanned copy should be clear enough * 6. Self Introduction and Study Plan The applicant should write a self-introduction and a Study Plan in Chinese or English, no less than 500 words for each. 7. 2 Recommendation Letters The Letters of Recommendation should be signed by a teacher & the principal of an applicant’s school respectively. Non-scholarship applicants are exempt from the Recommendation Letters. * 8. HSK-4 report (or above level) The applicant should submit 1 HSK-4 report (or above level). Applicants who have completed secondary school studies in Chinese & applicants study the program of TEACHING CHINESE TO SPEAKERS OF OTHER LANGUAGES are exempted from the HSK-4 reports. * 9. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
